kindOf.update: Proposed change to the live version

timeline.label: Conversation
timeline.lineCommentOld: @{username} commented on removed line {line} of revision {number}

comment.label: Add a comment
comment.hint: Feedback for the authors and reviewers, in plain text.
comment.closed: This review is closed, so it takes no more comments.

decision.title: Your review

hints.approved: Publishes revision {number} as the live version.
hints.changes_requested: Sends it back to the authors. Their next version reopens the review.
hints.rejectedFirst: Closes the review for good. The post won’t be published.
hints.rejectedUpdate: Closes the review for good. The live version stays as it is.

decision.messageHint: Required unless you approve. The authors read it in the conversation.

file.lineHelp: Select a line number to comment on that line.

against.live: Revision {number} compared with the live version (revision {base}).
against.none: Revision {number} is the first version, so everything is new.

changes.hidden: {count, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}
changes.summary: {added, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, one {# removed} other {# removed}}
changes.lineHelp: Select a line number to comment on that line: the old number on a removed line, the new number on any other.

revise.intoActive: Your new version joins review #{number} and goes back to the reviewers.
revise.newReview: This opens review #{number}. The live version stays as it is until an admin approves the change.
revise.closed: This post is closed, so it takes no new versions.
revise.onlyLatest: New versions go to the latest review.
revise.fileHint: Leave it empty to keep {fileName}. Up to 200 KB.
revise.noteHint: Added to the conversation with your revision.

authors.title: Authors
authors.addHint: Co-authors push versions and reply in reviews. Only you add or remove them.
authors.inviteHint: Whoever opens it while signed in joins as co-author. It works once and expires in 7 days.
authors.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.

withdraw.hintFirst: The post won’t be published. Its authors keep access to it.
withdraw.hintUpdate: Drops the proposed change. The live version stays as it is.

review.pickUsername: Pick a username to take part in reviews.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: You can’t do that on this post.
errors.notFound: We couldn’t find that. Reload the page and try again.
errors.closed: This review is closed. Reload the page to see its latest state.
errors.invalid: Some of what you sent isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Reviews aren’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.

queue.title: Reviews to do
queue.lead: Reviews waiting for a decision come first, oldest first. Then the ones waiting on their authors.

invite.title: Join “{title}” as co-author
invite.lead: Co-authors push new versions of the post and reply in its reviews. Your @username appears on its page.

states.used: This invite link was already used. Ask the post’s owner for a new one.
states.expired: This invite link has expired. Ask the post’s owner for a new one.
states.unknown: This invite link isn’t valid. Check that you copied all of it.

invite.signedOut: Sign in or create an account to accept the invite.
